nodes.description: _milker: IMilker contract instance implementing tokenomics events, set once by owner
_lastPeriod: number of the last happened round, used to gate round execution
_owner: address of the contract owner, set in constructor, gates privileged functions
round(): external entry point that plays a round using weak randomness and external calls
setMilker(address): onlyOwner one-time setter that assigns _milker
milker(): view getter returning the _milker address
lastPeriod(): view getter returning _lastPeriod
_randomNumber(): private view building a seed from block.timestamp, previous blockhashes and state
transferOwnership(address): onlyOwner function transferring ownership to newOwner
renounceOwnership(): onlyOwner function setting owner to the zero address
msg.sender: caller address used for owner access control checks
block.timestamp: block timestamp used in the randomness seed and event emission
External call to _milker.bandits(uint256): caller-controlled external contract call
External call to _milker.sheriffsVaultCommission(): caller-controlled external contract call
External call to _milker.sheriffsPotDistribution(): caller-controlled external contract call
Weak randomness: seed built from blockhash and block.timestamp is miner-manipulable
milker: address parameter of setMilker
newOwner: address parameter of transferOwnership
randomNumber: local uint256 derived from _randomNumber inside round
period: local uint256 obtained from _milker.getPeriod() inside round
banditsPercent: local uint256 passed to _milker.bandits inside round

edges.reason: _randomNumber result flows into round() to determine bandit/sheriff outcomes
block.timestamp is used as part of the randomness seed in _randomNumber
block.timestamp is emitted in the Round event of round()
_lastPeriod is included in the randomness seed in _randomNumber
round reads _lastPeriod to enforce the new round requirement
round writes the incremented value into _lastPeriod
round uses the _milker state variable for its external calls
setMilker writes the _milker state variable
milker() returns the _milker state variable
lastPeriod() returns the _lastPeriod state variable
milker parameter flows into setMilker and is assigned to _milker
newOwner parameter flows into transferOwnership and is assigned to _owner
randomNumber local derived from weak randomness is used in round()
period local returned by _milker.getPeriod() is used in round()
banditsPercent local flows into the _milker.bandits external call
_randomNumber performs the weak randomness operation using blockhash values
block.timestamp feeds the weak randomness operation
onlyOwner restricts setMilker to the account equal to _owner (msg.sender)
onlyOwner restricts transferOwnership to the current owner
onlyOwner restricts renounceOwnership to the current owner
round conditionally executes the _milker.bandits external call when bandits come
round always executes the _milker.sheriffsVaultCommission external call
round conditionally executes the _milker.sheriffsPotDistribution external call
caller-controlled _milker.bandits call could reenter round() before completion
caller-controlled _milker.sheriffsVaultCommission call could reenter round()
caller-controlled _milker.sheriffsPotDistribution call could reenter round()

normalization_plan.reason: milker is a parameter used only inside setMilker to assign the _milker state variable
newOwner is a parameter used only inside transferOwnership to assign _owner
randomNumber is a local variable computed and consumed inside round()
period is a local variable read from _milker and checked inside round()
banditsPercent is a local variable passed directly to the _milker.bandits external call
